title: Among customers who paid in CZK and belong to the SME segment, find the one
question: Among customers who paid in CZK and belong to the SME segment, find the one with the highest total consumption in 2013. For this customer, compute the percentage change in annual consumption from 2013 to 2014 (treating missing 2014 consumption as zero).

prediction.sql:
WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Total2013,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2014%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Total2014
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' 
      AND c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Total2013, Total2014
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    ORDER BY Total2013 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((Total2014 - Total2013) AS REAL) * 100 / Total2013 AS PercentageChange
FROM TopCustomer

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Total2013,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2014%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Total2014
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' 
      AND c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Total2013, Total2014
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    ORDER BY Total2013 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((Total2014 - Total2013) AS REAL) * 100 / Total2013 AS PercentageChange
FROM TopCustomer

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Total2013,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2014%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Total2014
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' 
      AND c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Total2013, Total2014
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    ORDER BY Total2013 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((Total2014 - Total2013) AS REAL) * 100 / Total2013 AS PercentageChange
FROM TopCustomer

WITH cze_sme AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'CZK'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'SME'
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2013' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2014' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2014
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN cze_sme cs ON t.XCL_013 = cs.customer_id
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cons_2013, cons_2014
    FROM consumption
    ORDER BY cons_2013 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (cons_2014 - cons_2013) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_change
FROM top_customer
